decisions.reason: The charting bundle extends the firm's core map.apps platform and is being actively iterated through frequent releases, so the firm's related knowledge and in-house R&D let it interpret feedback and improve the product.

The hierarchical search bundle is a small plugin close to the established web-map offer, so the firm can easily absorb results and maintain it at low cost, though its low visibility makes it slightly more likely to be folded into other components.

The mobile layer-control component builds on existing map-control expertise and was promoted on the home page, but as an experimental new solution approach it could be absorbed into broader mobile components.
The GIS solution-building platform is close to the firm's core architecture and enterprise integration knowledge, making it a strategic base product the firm will keep developing.
The mobile field data capture software is close to the firm's GIS and app development competence and has its own page, so the firm can learn from customer use and refine it.
The search extension for web map apps lies within the firm's established knowledge base and has its own page, so it fits the firm's capacity to assimilate and apply market feedback.
